Is Tinder Gold Worth It?

Tinder Gold is worth the money for people who already get likes and who buy a six or twelve month plan. At a full one-month price, it is a hard sell, because the plan saves time and does not create attraction.

Dark-Ero editorialUpdated 2026-11-1018+

At a glance

Gold's real feature is the grid of people who already liked you.

Trackers often show about 39.99 dollars for one US month, and much less on a yearly plan.

The price on your phone can differ, because Tinder prices the account, not the country.

Key takeaways

  • Plus removes friction. Gold shows who already liked you. Platinum adds priority on the likes you send.
  • Top Picks is no longer listed as a Gold perk on Tinder's own plan pages.
  • A weekly plan is the expensive way to try the product.
  • You cancel in the app store, and deleting the app does not stop the renewal.
  • Buy it for the time, and fix the photos before you pay.

Gold sits in the middle of Tinder's paid ladder, above Plus and under Platinum. The feature it actually sells is a grid of people who already swiped right on you.

The price tables and the fine print are in this is Tinder Gold worth it breakdown. Here is the decision, with the numbers treated as reports rather than a promise.

Disclosure: Dark-Ero is independent and this page has no affiliate link to Tinder. Adults 18+ only.

What Gold includes

You get the Plus set, and then the Gold extras. Plus is unlimited likes, unlimited rewinds, Passport, no ads, and an incognito mode that shows you only to people you have already liked.

Gold adds the Likes You grid, weekly Super Likes, and one free Boost a month on plans of one month or longer. Unused Super Likes and Boosts expire, and some accounts are left out of the Boost while Tinder tests the perk.

The grid is the product. A free user can swipe through a pile to find a mutual match, and a Gold user opens a short list of people who have already said yes.

You can open each profile, match immediately, or dismiss the like without the other person being told. That is a time saving, and it is only valuable if the grid has anyone on it.

Top Picks used to be sold as part of the plan, and Tinder's own subscription pages no longer list it for any tier. If the tab is still in your app, treat it as a leftover, not as a reason to pay.

What people actually pay

Tinder's public plan page lists features and does not list prices, because the app shows a personal rate at checkout. Age, city, plan length and ongoing tests all move the number.

Commonly reported US baselines, not prices Tinder publishes, put one month of Gold near 39.99 dollars. A six month plan is often quoted near 139.99 dollars, about 23 dollars a month, and a twelve month plan near 149.99 dollars, about 12.50 a month.

A one week plan is often near 18.99 dollars, which is the worst rate per day and the one the app likes to offer hesitant buyers. If a friend pays less, that is the pricing system working as designed, not a coupon you missed.

Our Tinder review is the longer note on that dynamic price. Two people in the same city can be shown different numbers, so the screenshot in a forum is not your bill.

The ranking site's Tinder review covers the same ladder. Read your own checkout before you argue with either of us.

Gold against Plus and Platinum

Plus is the budget rung, often reported near 24.99 dollars a month in the US, and it leaves you swiping blind. It is the sensible buy in a small town, where the likes grid would stay nearly empty.

Platinum is the top of the ordinary ladder, often reported near 49.99 dollars a month, and the extra Tinder documents is Priority Likes. Those are supposed to be seen sooner, which is a visibility claim Gold does not make.

An invite-only tier called Select sits above all of this, at a price in a different league, and almost nobody reading this was offered it. Ignore it when you are choosing between Plus and Gold.

Gold does not include a secret ranking boost. Tinder has not said the subscription itself lifts your profile, and the plan that sells visibility is Platinum.

What Gold users feel is indirect. Matching quickly and replying quickly are habits the app rewards, and the grid makes those habits easier, while swiping right on everyone can still hurt you.

Who should pay

Pay if you already see a blurred stack of likes on the free plan, you live where that stack refills, and you will take six or twelve months. The blurred counter is a free preview of the thing you are about to buy.

Skip it if the free plan shows almost nobody, if you are only curious, or if the offer in front of you is the weekly plan. Gold cannot display likes that do not exist, and a weak photo is a cheaper problem to fix.

Passport plus the grid is genuinely useful before a move, because you can build a queue in the new city. It is still a time tool, and a profile that does not get likes at home will not get them because the pin moved.

If Tinder is the wrong pool entirely, our best dating apps ranking is the wider map. Hinge and Bumble are the usual next stops when the goal is a date rather than a volume of matches.

The ranking site's best dating apps piece makes the same comparison. Changing apps does not refund a plan you forget to cancel.

Our Bumble review is the write-up if you want the other big app. Women message first there, which is a different product from a likes grid.

The ranking site's Bumble review is the companion note. Price it the same way, at the checkout, not from a blog table.

How the renewal works

Every length renews until you cancel it in the Apple or Google subscription settings. Deleting Tinder does not cancel Tinder, and the next charge will still arrive.

Sort the photos before you subscribe, with one clear solo picture in the first slot. Gold multiplies the profile it is attached to, including a bad one.

The rest of the dating shelf on this site is in best dating sites. Open a review before you add a second subscription beside Gold.

Our Adult Friend Finder review is the one for a more explicit dating pool. It is a different intent from Tinder, and a different bill.

The ranking site's Adult Friend Finder review covers that product's own paywall. Do not buy Gold and a second app in the same afternoon and then wonder which charge did what.

An outside pass on the Tinder ladder is this Tinder review. Use it to compare notes, and still trust the price on your screen.

Verdict

Buy Gold on a six or twelve month plan if the free likes counter is already busy. Skip the monthly and weekly prices, and skip the plan entirely if that counter is empty.

It will not fix the photos, and it will not invent matches. Cancel in the store the day you stop opening the app.

FAQ

How much is Tinder Gold?

Tinder does not publish one price. Commonly reported US rates put a single month near 39.99 dollars, a six month plan near 23 dollars a month, and a year near 12.50 dollars a month.

Your checkout can differ.

Does Gold show who liked me?

Yes. That grid is the feature Plus does not have and Platinum also includes.

It is only useful if people are already liking the profile.

Does Gold boost my profile?

Tinder has not said Gold includes a ranking boost. Priority Likes are a Platinum feature.

Any lift comes from matching and replying faster, which the grid makes easier.

Is the weekly plan a good trial?

It is usually the most expensive way to buy the same features, often near 18.99 dollars for seven days. If you are going to test Gold, look at a longer plan's monthly rate first.

How do I cancel?

Cancel in the Apple or Google subscription list, not by deleting the app. The plan renews until that store setting is off.
